GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away evenly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (6L from lead). Held Ground midrace until pushed to chase on inside @ 500m. Chasing on inside @ 400m & pressured 3 Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Worked home soundly in last 200m. # Sound last 150m.
Jumped Ok sat 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, battled on well just no match leader/winner # found 1 better
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination after dislodging the rider enroute to the barriers and cantered a short distance riderless. Was passed suitable to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Rolled fwd & raced behind leader on rail (2L from lead) early . Tracked leader on inside until back 2 Lengths @ 1000m & struggling to hold ground @ 800m. Gave ground from 650m. # Beaten @ 800m.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped another runner. Rider could offer no explanation for the disappointing performance after the gelding weakened significantly from near the 700m. Trainer reported the gelding may not have appreciated the quick back-up and raced flat. Trainer advised the gelding would undergo a stable veterinary inspection before determining future race plans. Vet no abs, will freshen up.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly & bumped @ start . Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (6L from lead). Stayed same improving slowly 3 Wide from 700m & pushed to quicken @ 550m. Pushed along Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Laid in @ 250m & held ground Four Wide in last 200m. # OK for easier.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted inwards and bumped another runner. Was hampered over the concluding stages when awkwardly placed on the heels of another runner which laid in before being corrected by the rider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok comf Went Forward Took sit Run Of Race 3rd Inside 2 Lengths held together same to turn Under Pressure x 400m run ended 300 had its chance - # had all favours
Jumped Ok Restrained Settled Down 7th Inside 7 Lengths off leader/winner Not Enough Pace On to assist, Hard Ridden @ 500m clear run home - # couldn't quicken
Jumped Fair settled back 8-9l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, kept one pace # back/no threat
Jumped Ok drifted back 8l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # poor
Jumped Ok Went Forward with Leader , sat 2nd 1l. 3l 4th midrace. Same and Ridden Along 600m. loomed out deep into Straight 4l away but even run home. vet = nil # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported his mount travelled comfortably in an off pace position throughout the early and middle stages. He said, as the tempo of the event quickened near the 800m, he commenced to ride his mount along, however the gelding failed to quicken and was only one-paced in the run to the line. A post-race vet exam did not reveal any abs.
